findings.reason: In Facts [F18] and proof step 2.1, continuity of the phase-space density is attributed to continuity-algebra and composition suppliers whose stated domains are subsets of R. They do not establish continuity for ρ on R^{2d}, so measurability of the graph integrands used in steps 2.1–3.1 is not established for arbitrary product-measurable C. Give a finite-dimensional measurability argument using the available coordinate-map and Borel-measurability results, or supply a valid multivariate continuity result.
